action.prompt: Run the Chitragupta Ledger smoke check: (1) node --check app.js; (2) ensure index.html, styles.css, app.js each return HTTP 200 from a local static server rooted at the project folder; (3) confirm no external URLs exist in the app files besides the Google Fonts link in index.html. Report PASS/FAIL per step with failing output. Do not edit any file.

description: On save of the app files, syntax-check app.js, verify the static server returns 200 for /, styles.css and app.js, and enforce the zero-external-assets rule.
name: smoke-check-on-save
